tasks.subject: Day-one triage: identify pack type (bid/RFQ/RFI/EOI - judge by content) and regime (SBD/MBD/SOE/CIDB/RFQ), closing date, briefing date; diarise the bidder-question and addenda cut-offs SEPARATELY; sweep for contradictions including the submission channel itself

Build the page-by-page master checklist of returnables from the pack - sweep by title for POPIA, DPIP/FPPO, Integrity Pact, litigation-history, single-submission certificate, lot tick-boxes and method-of-pricing forms
Check the Tender Data's functionality clause (some packs score none); extract the matrix, threshold (corpus range 40-83%) and any zero-anywhere rule; go/no-go against a realistic self-score
Check where B-BBEE sits: preference-points table (soft gate - still submit without it) vs pass/fail pre-qualification table (hard gate - proof at closing or dead)
Flag objective-criteria (PPPFA s2(1)(f)) and security-vetting exposure at go/no-go: track record with this buyer, litigation, financial ratios, clearance-ready personnel
Refresh the universal gate evidence: CSD report, TCS PIN, defaulters check, CIPC certified set, B-BBEE evidence
Complete all mandatory forms on the official issued copies (SBD/MBD 1, 4, 6.1 and the rest of the pack's spread)
Complete the pricing schedule: every line priced, arithmetic self-audit, totals reconciled to the cover form
Commissioner of Oaths session: affidavits and certified copies (under 3 months, from originals)
Final pre-submission checklist with a second person independently re-verifying every line
Deliver / upload at least 24 hours before closing; keep the lodgement receipt and a complete copy
Confirm the preference system from the tender-specific clause (80/20 vs 90/10) - the tender-specific text governs over boilerplate
SBD 4: answer every question individually; disclose all CSD-linked director companies
SBD 6.1: write points per goal and attach the exact proof per goal
SBD 1: fill every field, total price on the face of the form, signed with capacity and proof of authority
Final checklist, second-person verification, submit 24 hours early
Start collecting municipal rates clearances for the company AND every director on day one - arrears threshold is buyer-specific (1-3 months; check when it bites)
Check whether the procurement exceeds R10m: MBD 5 plus three years' audited AFS required
Complete MBD 8 and MBD 9 as separate signed returnables
MBD 1: total price on the face of the form; MBD 4 and 6.1 complete with proofs
Assume single-shot (no cure window): everything in the box at closing; deliver 24 hours early

Verify CIDB grading: exact class and designation, ACTIVE status, valid through the validity period - if not held, check the eligibility clause for a 21-working-day registration grace period (proof of application at closing) before self-eliminating

Read the eligibility/qualifying-criteria clause (F.2.1) IN FULL and register every criterion as a hard gate - keyword extraction alone misses grading, JV formalities, personnel qualifications and financial capacity
JV route: signed JV agreement before submission; book the notary where the pack demands an authenticated formation document
COIDA Letter of Good Standing current; H&S Plan and Quality Control Plan drafted per the pack's specifications
C1.1 Form of Offer: total price in words AND figures, signed and witnessed; price carried over from the pricing/activity schedule
Confirm performance-guarantee and retention capacity with the bank/insurer before committing
ORIGINAL + COPY sealed packages per the pack's packaging clause; deliver 24 hours early
Confirm the two-stage mechanics: functionality-only gate to join the panel (price may not be submitted at panel stage at all), then per-order RFQ mini-competitions among panelists
Go/no-go on panel economics: entry buys the right to compete, not revenue - estimated quantities are NOT guaranteed volume; price each unit to be viable at any volume
Check panel-regime traps: one-area/lot caps, leased-equipment cross-checks against other bidders' fleets, performance-penalty/greylisting regimes
Build the functionality evidence pack to the panel threshold (municipal panels regularly sit at 50-55%)
Post-award: answer every per-order RFQ invitation - repeatedly ignoring invitations is a removal ground at some buyers
Judge by content, not the cover page: check whether this 'RFQ' is actually a formal bid
Complete SBD 4 and SBD 6.1 with the same care as a formal bid - the core kill-rules apply in full
Price every line, attach the universal gate evidence, submit on the exact prescribed channel
